testimonies.testimony: I went to the shack at around 9, so it would have been about 10:30 PM...
I was lying under my bedding when a white flash almost blinded me!
I looked out the window... and Dusky Bridge was on fire!
There was still some thunder, but I went right away to check it out.
That's when I ran into Nick.
I arrived at the bridge, and Nick showed up less than a minute later.

source.testimony_span: I arrived at the bridge, and Nick showed up less than a minute later.
source.explanation: According to the weather report, the lightning fell at 10:45 PM. It takes less than five minutes from the shack to Dusky Bridge, meaning the witness got to the bridge before 11 PM, which was when the murder happened. Around that time, Phoenix Wright was in the courtyard, so the witness could not have met him.

turns.summarizedContext: The witness Butz is describing his whereabouts on the night of the murder which happened at about 11 PM. Around that time, Phoenix 'Nick' was in the courtyard far away, hearing about the murder. Butz was staying in a shack that is a 5-minute walk from the Eagle Bridge.
reasoning: Fact 1: The witness claims Phoenix was there soon after he arrived at the bridge.
Fact 2: The witness also claims he walked from the shack to the bridge when the bridge caught fire
Fact 3: The evidence suggests lightning struck at around 10:45.
Fact 4: The first context suggests the murder happened at around 11:00.
Fact 5: The second context suggests it took the witness 5 minutes to walk from the shack to the bridge.
Fact 6: The third context suggests Phoenix is at the courtyard, not the bridge, around the time of the murder.
Prop 1: If a bridge is struck by lightning, it may catch fire.
Prop 2: If someone leaves at 10:45 for a 5-minute trip, they arrive at around 11:00.
Prop 3: If someone participates in an event in location A around 11:00, they cannot be in location B.
